title: Nvidia-backed company nearly doubles valuation in new funding round
excerpt: Former Bitcoin miner Firmus has raised $2 billion in fresh equity funding, nearly doubling its valuation as investors continue pouring capital into artificia...
content_html:
Former Bitcoin miner Firmus has raised $2 billion in fresh equity funding, nearly doubling its valuation as investors continue pouring capital into artificial intelligence infrastructure.

The Aug. 7 funding round included follow-on participation from Nvidia and Coatue Management, alongside funds managed by Blackstone and trading firm Jane Street.

The raise pushed Firmus' post-money valuation above $10.5 billion, up from $5.5 billion.

Related: What is Bitcoin mining? Explained

Firmus said it will use the capital to accelerate Project Southgate, its planned network of AI training and inference facilities across Australia, while expanding into the wider Asia-Pacific region.

"This investment allows us to move on multiple fronts at once," Firmus co-CEO Oliver Curtis said, adding that the company is scaling in Australia while accelerating expansion across Asia-Pacific, including its recently announced development in Indonesia.

Firmus' shift mirrors a broader trend among Bitcoin miners, which have increasingly redirected power infrastructure toward AI and high-performance computing.

Core Scientific, Cango and Bitdeer are among miners that have sold Bitcoin to help finance AI infrastructure expansion.

MARA also sold about $1.5 billion worth of Bitcoin during the first quarter as it expanded its focus on power and AI infrastructure.

More on Polymarket:

  • Bitcoin service shuts down after wave of AI attacks

  • U.S. senators seek ban on wildfire betting

  • Strategy stages comeback, surges to $100

Firmus' Bitcoin mining roots

Founded in 2019, Firmus initially focused on cryptocurrency mining before pivoting toward AI infrastructure.

In 2025, the company unveiled Project Southgate, a plan to develop large-scale AI infrastructure across Australia.

Firmus raised another round in April 2026 that valued the company at $5.5 billion, with Nvidia participating as an investor.

Its relationship with Nvidia expanded in late June, when the companies struck an agreement for Firmus to acquire Nvidia infrastructure and provide Nvidia-powered cloud services.

Firmus also announced plans for an AI factory in Indonesia as part of its regional expansion.

The latest $2 billion raise has now nearly doubled Firmus' valuation in four months, reflecting growing investor demand for the physical infrastructure supporting AI rather than solely the software companies building AI products.

content_html_zh:
前比特币矿商 Firmus 筹集了 20 亿美元的新股权资金，随着投资者继续向人工智能基础设施注入资金，其估值几乎翻了一番。

8 月 7 日的这轮融资包括 Nvidia 和 Coatue Management 的后续参与，以及 Blackstone 和贸易公司 Jane Street 管理的基金的参与。

此次融资将 Firmus 的投后估值从 55 亿美元推升至 105 亿美元以上。

相关：什么是比特币挖矿？ 解释

Firmus表示，将利用这笔资金加速Project Southgate项目，该项目计划在澳大利亚建立人工智能训练和推理设施网络，同时扩展到更广泛的亚太地区。

Firmus 联合首席执行官奥利弗·柯蒂斯 (Oliver Curtis) 表示：“这项投资使我们能够同时在多个领域开展业务。”他补充说，该公司正在澳大利亚扩大规模，同时加速在亚太地区的扩张，包括最近宣布的在印度尼西亚的开发项目。

Firmus 的转变反映了比特币矿工的更广泛趋势，他们越来越多地将电力基础设施转向人工智能和高性能计算。

Core Scientific、Cango 和 Bitdeer 等矿工出售比特币，为人工智能基础设施扩张提供资金。

随着 MARA 扩大对电力和人工智能基础设施的关注，第一季度还出售了价值约 15 亿美元的比特币。

  • 美国参议员寻求禁止野火博彩
  • 策略卷土重来，飙升至100美元

Firmus 的比特币挖矿根源

Firmus 成立于 2019 年，最初专注于加密货币挖矿，然后转向人工智能基础设施。

2025 年，该公司推出了 Project Southgate，该计划旨在在澳大利亚开发大规模人工智能基础设施。

Firmus 于 2026 年 4 月筹集了另一轮融资，估值为 55 亿美元，Nvidia 作为投资者参与其中。

6 月下旬，Firmus 与 Nvidia 的关系进一步扩大，两家公司达成了一项协议，让 Firmus 收购 Nvidia 基础设施并提供由 Nvidia 驱动的云服务。

作为区域扩张的一部分，Firmus 还宣布了在印度尼西亚建设人工智能工厂的计划。

最新的 20 亿美元融资在四个月内使 Firmus 的估值几乎翻了一番，反映出投资者对支持人工智能的物理基础设施的需求不断增长，而不仅仅是构建人工智能产品的软件公司。
